name: Quake III / ioquake3 / Quake3e
note: Populate baseq3/ from an existing Quake III installation (including its patch PK3 files); optional Team Arena content goes in missionpack/.

name: DOOM 3 / dhewm3
note: Populate base/ from DOOM 3 1.3.1, not BFG Edition. Optional Resurrection of Evil data goes in d3xp/.

name: Quake II / Yamagi
note: Populate baseq2/ with original Quake II data; optional expansions xatrix/ and rogue/. Version 8.70 uses existing ~/.yq2/ first, otherwise $XDG_DATA_HOME/YamagiQ2/ (default ~/.local/share/YamagiQ2/). This report resolves that precedence. Custom -cfgdir/-datadir/-portable arguments require manual review.

name: Prey / Prey2006
note: Populate base/ with the original Prey PC data. Alternate system search root: /usr/local/share/games/prey06/. Do not put assets in the config-only ~/.config/prey06 directory.

name: ET Legacy
note: Populate etmain/ next to ET Legacy.app with original Enemy Territory PK3 files. The user-support directory stores profiles/downloads. Paths follow the actual installed engine folder.

name: Unreal Tournament
note: Populate Maps/, Sounds/, Textures/ and Music/. Do not copy the original System/ folder over the patch. Compressed .uz maps require manual decompression.

name: UT2004 (existing/manual engine)
note: Populate Animations/, Help/, KarmaData/, Maps/, Music/, Prefabs/, Sounds/, Speech/, StaticMeshes/, Textures/, Web/. Do not copy the original System/ folder. Current engine channel is preview, so fresh engine installation is manual.

name: SuperTux / SuperTuxKart
note: Distribution packages include their resources; no additional data required.

name: Steam / GOG / Battle.net
note: Library paths are chosen in each launcher. Steam default shown; GOG/Battle.net game folders are user-selectable. Sign in and install content manually; the script does not populate these folders.

name: Maelstrom
note: Native Mac Source Ports app includes its resources; no additional data directory to populate.
